title: Employee onboarding sample
description: Generic nontechnical training with three required units.

nodes.title: Workplace safety
nodes.body:
# Workplace safety

Read the organization safety procedure and identify the emergency contact.

nodes.title: First-day checklist
nodes.body:
# First-day checklist

Complete the tracked account task.

nodes.title: Check account access
nodes.body:
# Check account access

Confirm the test account can open the onboarding portal. Do not submit credentials.

nodes.title: First-day summary
nodes.body:
# First-day summary

Write a short summary and self-confirm completion; evidence can be attached.
